subject: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep dive with ML/infra (60-90m)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@acmehealthtech.com>
Cc: James Park <james.park@acmehealthtech.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep dive with ML/infra (60-90m)

Hi Sarah — great to meet earlier today. Thanks for walking us through your ingestion flow and core latency constraints. Quick recap:

- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood for low-latency clinical note summarization and embedding index serving for search.
- Scale: ~20M clinical notes initially, peak concurrent inference ~120 QPS during batch runs, lower sustained API usage.
- Requirements: HIPAA controls (VPC + KMS), predictable p99 latency under 250ms for short prompts, ability to run a 60-90 minute technical deep dive with your ML/infra folks to validate integrations.

Next step: propose a 60-90 minute technical deep dive with our ML/infra + solutions engineering team to go over architecture, auth/KMS, networking, and a short live demo of model serving + KV cache performance. Can your team do any of these windows?

- Wed 23 Jun — 10:00-11:30 PT
- Wed 23 Jun — 14:00-15:30 PT
- Thu 24 Jun — 09:00-10:30 PT

Agenda (draft):
1) 10 mins — introductions & success criteria
2) 20 mins — ingestion & data flow review (Acme)
3) 25 mins — Redwood architecture, private deployment options, KMS / audit logs
4) 25 mins — demo: low-latency serving + caching, quantization tradeoffs
5) 10-15 mins — Q&A & next steps

I’ve cc'd Camila (our SE) — she’ll lead the demo. If you have folks from infra/ML ops, please include them on the reply. I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0139

Attachments: Redwood_Tech_Deep_Dive_Agenda.pdf (agenda & proposed deep-dive checklist)

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@acmehealthtech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: James Park <james.park@acmehealthtech.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep dive with ML/infra (60-90m)

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and aligns with what we discussed. We can do Wed 23 Jun 14:00-15:30 PT.

I'll loop in the ML infra leads: James (cc'd) and Priya (I'll add her on the calendar invite). High level asks from our side:
- Confirm whether Redwood can support customer-managed KMS for key rotation audits
- Network topology examples for private deployment (VPC peering / private endpoints)
- A short checklist of the data we should prepare for the dry run (sample payloads, sizes, and anonymization expectations)

Also, could you include your SOC2 artifact or a summary? Happy to review ahead of the call.

Appreciate it — Sarah
Director of ML Platforms | Acme Health Tech
sarah@acmehealthtech.com

Perfect — locking Wed 23 Jun 14:00-15:30 PT. 

@James / @Priya — thanks for joining. For the deep dive we'll have Camila run through the demo and I've asked Dylan (infra) to be available for networking/KMS/ops-level questions. Quick notes ahead of the call:

- SOC2: attaching SOC2 summary (SOC2-overview.pdf) — we can discuss any specific audit artifacts during the call; we can run a narrow evidence review after NDA if helpful.
- KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via KMS and can be configured in our private deployment; Dylan will walk through the options.
- Network: we'll cover VPC peering vs private endpoints and what ports/proxies are required.
- Data prep: can you share a sample anonymized payload (JSON) and expected max token length? If it's easier, drop into the Google Drive link I sent and I'll pull it before the call.

I'll send the calendar invite + Zoom link in a separate email. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
Marissa
